Your familiarity with turrets and defensive emplacements lets you scramble their targeting. As a bonus action, you can activate a masking field for 1 minute; any construct that targets you with an attack, harmful power, or hostile action must first succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your tech save DC or be forced to pick a different target, losing that attack or power. Area effects bypass this protection.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus (per the scout table), regaining all uses on completing a long rest.
